svg.aria-label: Demo conversation, not live messaging. You: Any ideas for a quick dinner? Your agent: Try lemon pasta with olive oil and a green salad. Ready in 20 minutes. You, replying directly to Your agent’s suggestion: Perfect, pasta it is!
